items.title: The NVK driver for Linux was 18% slower than the GeForce Game Ready Driver in Cyberpunk 2077
items.summary: Enthusiasts conducted a direct technical performance comparison Cyberpunk 2077 running the Linux operating system using two...
items.content:
Login without a password Sign In Forgot your password? Forgot your username? News GAMES The NVK driver for Linux was 18% slower than the GeForce Game Ready Driver in Cyberpunk 2077 Maxim Boldson GAMES October 25 2026 Views: 1318

Enthusiasts conducted a direct technical performance comparison Cyberpunk 2077 Under the Linux operating system, using two different graphics packages. The benchmarks compared the official proprietary NVIDIA GeForce Game Ready Driver version 615.71 and a modified open-source NVK stack based on Mesa 26.3.0-devel. Tests were conducted at a resolution of 1920x1200 with low texture quality and RT Overdrive path tracing enabled. The benchmark configuration utilized DLSS Super Resolution upscaling algorithms with the Transformer Model preset in automatic mode, DLSS Ray Reconstruction, and DLSS frame generation. Frame GenerationA laptop with an Intel Core processor was used as the hardware base. Ultra 9 275HX, 31509 MB of RAM and an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 mobile graphics card Laptop GPU with 8151 MB of video memory.

The built-in benchmark recorded a numeric difference in frame rate between the two software solutions. The official NVIDIA GeForce Game Ready Driver showed an average frame rate of 71 FPS, a minimum of 38 FPS, and a maximum peak of 131 FPS, with a total of 6656 rendered frames. The modified open-source NVK driver demonstrated an average frame rate of 58 FPS, a maximum of 74 FPS, and a total of 5832 rendered frames. Moreover, the open-source Mesa-based solution outperformed the proprietary package in terms of minimum frame rate, achieving 39 FPS versus the official package's 38 FPS.

A comparison of benchmarks revealed different peak and steady frame rates in a demanding graphics mode with path tracing. The proprietary package demonstrated higher average and maximum frame rates due to higher peak values, but had a lower minimum frame rate. The modified NVK driver performed worse in terms of average and maximum values, but recorded a higher minimum frame rate and provided a smaller spread of extreme values ​​during rendering.

items.title: Half of Cyberpunk 2's Quest Team Are Former Modders, Says Associate Game Director
items.summary: CDPR's Paweł Sasko called modding a "foot-in-the-door technique and a gateway into gamedev."
items.content:
CDPR's Paweł Sasko called modding a "foot-in-the-door technique and a gateway into gamedev."

Cyberpunk 2 A ssociate Game Director Paweł Sasko reveals that h alf of the quest team at CD PROJEKT RED are former modders.

In a recent livestream on the official CDPR YouTube channel, held on October 21, which was dedicated to the new Cyberpunk 2077 update inspired by the second season of the anime Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , Sasko expressed his support for modding, calling it a "foot-in-the-door technique and a gateway into gamedev," and shared that many of CDPR's current developers previously created mods: " We actually hired so many modders. I would say, at this point, half of the quest team is all former modders."

"Modding community is really keeping the game alive," Sasko said. "I'm very often looking at what our modders are doing, what they're building. It's very exciting. There's so much creativity, and we, as a studio, always tried to support our modding community as much as we could."

The stream also touched on updates for Cyberpunk 2077, including cross-platform mod support for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and Xbox Series X|S.

You can watch the full REDstream episode below:

Last year, CDPR expanded its teams working on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 . Previously, the developer said that Cyberpunk 2 was in pre-production. The sequel to Cyberpunk 2077, initially codenamed Project Orion, was unveiled in October 2022 and is being developed with Unreal Engine 5 by a North American division comprising studios in Boston and Vancouver.

Cyberpunk 2077 is CDPR's top-performing title with over 40 million copies sold . It is getting a standalone VR experience , co-developed by CDPR and Zero Latency VR, and a live-action film adaptation , which is in development at Paramount.

Report: Activision Is Working on an Open-World Game With a Reactive Environment and “Emergent Gameplay”
items.summary: Activision is reportedly working on an open-world game with a reactive environment and emergent gameplay, based on a recent job listing.
items.content:
When companies are not busy chasing trends like games as a service, they go after big-budget hits. And very few games can match the sales of the GTA and Cyberpunk 2077 series.

GTA 6 is unrivaled, but its open-world style is used in other games too. Cyberpunk 2077 also made its mark, and more and more games are copying it.

Now, Activision has a new open-world project in the works at Elsewhere, a new studio that has brought in veteran developers from prominent studios like CD Projekt Red and Naughty Dog. The game is built around emergent gameplay, and it looks set to take on the biggest names in the genre.

The Elsewhere project is taking shape, and it is certainly ambitious. In fact, the studio urgently needs staff, as a recent job posting confirms. The posting asks for an Associate Animation Director, who will have two main jobs: creating interactions in a dynamic world and defining emergent gameplay. It never names GTA or Cyberpunk, but the kind of game it describes puts Elsewhere in the same space.

The job description reads, “You’ll help us by guiding the development of scalable animation systems that support emergent gameplay, contextual behaviors, and dynamic world interactions.”

In case you don’t know, emergent gameplay is when a game’s systems, like its AI, physics, and world rules, work together in ways the developers never scripted. Nobody plans the moment ahead of time. It just happens when the systems run into each other, so every player ends up with their own stories.

GTA 5 is the best-known example. Say you pick a fight with a civilian, who runs off and bumps into a gang member. The gang member pulls a gun and accidentally shoots a nearby cop car. Suddenly the police are in a huge shootout with the gang while you just stand back and watch. No one wrote that scene. The game’s AI systems created it on their own.

With that in mind, these are broad terms, but they give us a good idea of what kind of game Elsewhere is making. It seems to also focus on reactive gameplay, like in titles such as Red Dead Redemption 2.

With this kind of gameplay, a lot could happen. Characters could remember what we did, places could change as we move through them, and some NPCs could even want revenge on us, like in the Nemesis System from Shadow of War.

It is hard not to think of two games that already have these features: Cyberpunk 2077 and GTA 5. GTA 6 is expected to go even bigger, with much more ambition and emergent gameplay.

This does not mean Elsewhere wants to copy these games, or even beat them. It just wants to stand next to them, or at least find its own place in the genre they created.

This is also a change in direction for Activision, which is more used to linear experiences like Call of Duty. To find the company’s last true open-world game, we have to go back to 2012, when it released Prototype 2.

As more information about the project becomes available, we’ll make sure to let you guys know here at MP1st.

items.title: You Missed Cyberpunk 2077’s V In ‘Cyberpunk: Edgerunners’ Season 2
Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 Adds Edgerunners 2’s Crew, Dual-Wielding, and Console Mods, as CDPR Lures Players Back to Night City
items.summary: Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 is now live on most platforms, adding Edgerunners 2's crew, dual-wielding pistols or revolvers, and new content.
items.content:
CD Projekt RED has just given Cyberpunk 2077 players another substantial reason to return to Night City with Update 2.5 , also known as the Edgerunners 2 Update , now live on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and the Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store versions on Mac. Nintendo Switch 2 and the Mac App Store version will receive it in the coming days. Despite its anime-themed cover, this is far more than a complimentary patch with crossover items, adding quests, dual wielding, cyberware customization, cross-platform mod support, and tech improvements .

During the accompanying REDstreams presentation , Associate Game Director Paweł Sasko said the team wanted to deliver something more substantial than Update 1.6's tie-in with the original Edgerunners season in 2022. The studio's goal was to make Night City feel more alive while giving returning players new ways to experience it . The patch was co-developed with Virtuos , which also contributed to several previous Cyberpunk 2077 updates.

The crossover with the animated TV series takes place in Clampdown , a new side quest set before Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. According to the stream, it involves the last job of King's team and lets players meet King, Mishuga, Miguel, and Emily . The quest was developed alongside the people at STUDIO TRIGGER working on the anime, with returning voice actors helping maintain consistency between the two productions. To unlock the mission, players must complete The Heist and two gigs for Wakako, then wait for her message. The quest also offers a five-piece equipment set based on King's appearance. That's not all, either: the new HKGN 102.0 FM radio station brings 16 songs from the two Edgerunners series into the game, letting players take more of the anime’s soundtrack along on their drives through Night City.

One of the biggest gameplay additions is Double Trouble , a new perk in the Cool attribute tree that allows V to dual-wield Power-category pistols and revolvers. Four auxiliary perks support the new playstyle, which also gets its own special Photo Mode poses.

Players can mix and match compatible weapons, including Iconics , while retaining their individual effects. There are penalties involved, and the selected perks influence how effective those combinations become. Sasko explained that restricting the feature to pistols and revolvers was a deliberate balancing decision: letting players run around with two shotguns would have required a rather different approach. Still, it's a surprisingly meaningful addition for anyone considering another playthrough . The developers specifically highlighted the opportunity to experiment with combinations such as Jackie’s guns.

Arguably the update's most impactful long-term addition is integrated mod support powered by mod.io . Whereas PC players were the only ones benefitting from mods and had to do it the hard way, using third-party launchers and injectors, any Cyberpunk 2077 player can now browse and install a selection of community creations directly through an in-game menu . CDPR described this as a first step into cross-platform modding, with more mods becoming available over time.

During the stream, the developers said they worked closely with some of the established Cyberpunk modders to prepare the launch selection , including cosmetic additions, gameplay changes, and new quests. The menu supports downloading, enabling, and disabling mods, although Sasko cautioned that combining too many can destabilize the game. Additional functionality is planned in the weeks following launch.

There is an important caveat for console players: achievements and trophies cannot be earned while playing from a modded save . Such saves are now identified with a dedicated icon in the Load Game menu.

Update 2.5 introduces five Glamdocs , new characters who specialize in changing the appearance of V’s arm cyberware. Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire, and the Projectile Launch System can all receive new looks, with 40 styles discussed during the stream. Each Glamdoc has a distinct shop and an introductory scene featuring new voiceover and animation.

Customization includes color options, though these follow the identities of the relevant corporations and factions rather than allowing unrestricted palettes. The developers used Arasaka as an example: expect variations on its recognizable blacks and reds rather than bright pink hardware. More colorful alternatives are available elsewhere.

The patch also adds five clothing collections : Maxiwear, Jinguji, NetWatch, and IconAmerica outfits distributed among vendors, with another collection arriving later. The previously promotional NUS Infiltrator set becomes purchasable in Kabuki and Japantown, while four new TWINTONE skins for the Quadra Turbo-R V-Tech are available through Twitch Drops. Some formerly NPC-exclusive hairstyles are now available to V, too.

On the narrative side, Welcome to Paradise sends players on a guided tour narrated by Night City founder Richard Night . It unlocks after The Heist and Street Cred level 15, and the developers recommend paying attention to discrepancies between the narration and what is actually visible around you. There is supposedly a mystery beneath the sightseeing.

Finally, players can discover 12 new Minor Arcana tarot cards through an extension of Fool on the Hill, earning a special reward for finding the complete set.

The technical additions are important, too. Update 2.5 adds in-game NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 support , including up to 6X Multi Frame Generation, Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and the second-generation transformer model. There is also support for MetalFX Frame Interpolation on Mac and glasses-free 3D on compatible Samsung Odyssey 3D monitors , with settings to adjust viewing comfort. HDR rendering has reportedly been improved on compatible displays with more accurate colors, brightness, and contrast.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 Brings Mods to 6 Platforms [2026]
items.summary: Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 adds cross-platform mod support via mod.io on PC, Mac, PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 2. Here is whats confirmed.
items.content:
Cyberpunk 2077 is getting cross-platform mod support in Update 2.5, and for the first time, console players will be able to browse and install player-made mods without ever touching a PC. CD Projekt Red confirmed the feature as part of a broader update tied to the arrival of Edgerunners 2 on Netflix, and the official platform list covers PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2 , according to patch notes reported by Nintendo Life .

What’s Actually In Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 How mod.io Powers Cross-Platform Mod Support Which Platforms Get Mod Support First Where Nintendo Switch 2 Fits Into the Rollout The Achievement and Trophy Trade-Off Why CD Projekt Red Is Doing This Now How This Compares to The Witcher 3’s Console Mod Support Console Modding’s Slow Build: Some Historical Context The Bethesda.net Era The Shift to Shared Service Platforms Market Impact: What This Means for CD Projekt Red Competitive Landscape: Who Else Is Building Console Mod Ecosystems What’s Still Unconfirmed About Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 What’s Next: Five Predictions for Cross-Platform Cyberpunk 2077 Modding How to Prepare for Mod Support on Console The Bigger Picture for Console Players Frequently Asked Questions Related Coverage The move puts Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 in rare company. Console mod support has existed in pockets for years, but a built-in, cross-platform browsing system that spans six hardware targets at once, including a Nintendo console, is a different scale of ambition. shattered.io first flagged Update 2.5’s existence when the Edgerunners 2 tie-in was announced, and the mod-support detail is the part that’s generating the most discussion among players this week.

Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google

Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.

At the center of the update is a new in-game menu that lets players browse a curated selection of mods and install them directly, without downloading files externally or touching a file system. That’s the headline change, and it’s the one CD Projekt Red is leaning on hardest in its own messaging. The patch notes describe cross-platform mod support as “a first step into cross-platform modding,” language that signals this is an opening move rather than a finished ecosystem, according to reporting from The Verge .

The week's biggest stories in tech, gaming and security, in one email.

That phrasing matters for how players should read this update. CD Projekt Red isn’t claiming console modding is suddenly as deep as PC modding has been for years through Nexus Mods and other community tools. Instead, Update 2.5 opens a narrower, officially sanctioned channel, one that the studio can moderate, curate, and expand incrementally. The announcement is explicit that more mods are planned to become available over time, which reads as an admission that the day-one catalog is a starting point, not the finished product.

Beyond mod support, Update 2.5 is also the vehicle for content tied to Edgerunners 2, the Netflix anime continuation that shattered.io covered in detail in its earlier report on the Netflix and game update pairing . Bundling a major new feature like mod support with a marketing moment tied to a streaming release is a familiar CD Projekt Red playbook: pair a cultural event with a technical one so each amplifies the other’s reach.

The technical backbone of Cyberpunk 2077’s cross-platform mod support is mod.io, a third-party mod distribution platform that several studios have adopted specifically because it’s built to work within console certification rules. Unlike Steam Workshop or Nexus Mods, which were designed around open PC file systems, mod.io operates as a managed layer: developers can expose a curated, sandboxed subset of community content to console players while keeping the kind of file-system access consoles don’t allow locked down.

That distinction explains why this works differently than PC modding. On PC, Cyberpunk 2077 players have had essentially unrestricted mod access since launch, installing anything from cosmetic tweaks to total gameplay overhauls through community tools. On console, through mod.io, the pool is necessarily smaller and more tightly reviewed, because every mod has to pass through a layer that platform holders like Sony, Microsoft, and Nintendo are comfortable certifying.

Reporting from PC Guide notes that CD Projekt Red has described the system as working similarly to the console mod support already shipped for The Witcher 3’s remaster. That’s a useful reference point for players who’ve already used Witcher 3’s mod browser on console: the user experience Cyberpunk 2077 ships with in Update 2.5 should feel familiar rather than experimental, because it’s built on groundwork the studio already tested.

Here’s where the Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 rollout gets more nuanced than a single simultaneous launch. The officially listed platforms, PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2, all appear in the confirmed feature list. But the available reporting indicates Nintendo Switch 2’s version of the update is not arriving on the same day as the rest. Switch 2 is on the roadmap; it’s just not first in line.

That staggered approach tracks with how CD Projekt Red has handled Switch 2 releases before. The studio has a track record of launching its biggest Cyberpunk 2077 content on PC and the PlayStation and Xbox ecosystems first, then following with the Nintendo version once additional porting and certification work wraps up. shattered.io has tracked that pattern closely around Switch 2 ports generally, including in its breakdown of how Switch 2’s storage requirements shape what kind of content can land on the console and when.

The table above reflects the officially confirmed platform list for Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5’s cross-platform mod support as reported by Nintendo Life and corroborated elsewhere. The one open variable is exactly when Switch 2 owners get their turn, and neither CD Projekt Red nor the outlets tracking the story have published a firm date for that yet.

items.title: From the Anime to the Game — Free Update Brings Edgerunners 2 Content and More to Cyberpunk 2077!
items.summary: The free Edgerunners 2 Update to Cyberpunk 2077 is available now, with content inspired by the second installment of the hit anime series now streaming on Netflix
items.content:
“Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2” premiered on Netflix on October 20, bringing a whole new cast of characters to Night City for a dark, gritty ride. And now we’re bringing a little piece of that story into Cyberpunk 2077 , too! The free Edgerunners 2 Update is here, with content inspired by the anime, new ways to fight, more customization options, and plenty of other additions.

We’ve got a lot to cover, so let’s get into it. And don’t worry if you haven’t watched the new anime yet — no “Edgerunners 2” spoilers ahead!

One of the things we love about Night City is that there’s always another story unfolding somewhere. V may be central to the events of Cyberpunk 2077 , but they’re hardly the only merc in town, fighting to survive and make a name for themselves on those neon-soaked streets. Every fixer has clients, every crew has gigs to take care of, every Night City merc has their story — and sometimes, those stories collide in unexpected ways.

That’s exactly what happens in the brand-new quest introduced with the “Edgerunners 2” Update. What begins as just another gig from Wakako turns into an action-packed, high-stakes mission that sees V cross paths with Weak Kingsley, a famed Night City merc and one of the main characters of “Edgerunners 2.” We won’t spoil what happens, but during the course of this mission, V has a chance to assist Weak and his crew during a risky gig that takes place in a brand-new location: Night City Prison.

The new “Edgerunners 2” gig is more than a chance to encounter characters from the anime in the game — it serves as a prequel to the events of the series. So, play the quest before watching the anime, and you’ll have a little extra context going into Episode 1. Already seen the show? Then with this gig, you’ll get to revisit part of Weak’s story with a broader perspective of him and his crew.

And there’s even more forEdgerunnersfans in this update. For starters, you can find and equip Weak’s full outfit — vest, glasses, coat, pants, the works — and get your hands on his signature revolver, Coronation. We’ve also added a new radio station, HKGN 102.FM, featuring official tracks from both “Cyberpunk: Edgerunners” and “Edgerunners 2.” So if you’re planning to spend a few more hours cruising around Night City after watching the show, we’ve got your soundtrack covered.

What’s better than blasting your way through a warehouse full of gangoons with a revolver, dealing one headshot after another? Doing it with two revolvers, obviously.

That’s right — dual wielding is here! With the Edgerunners 2 Update, you can raise hell with a pistol or revolver in each hand. That’s a whole new vibe — and a whole new level of awesome.

But dual wielding isn’t just about looking cool. It brings a new playstyle and a fresh way to approach combat — in fact, it’s one of the most significant gameplay additions to the game’s combat since Update 2.0 introduced throwing knives. So if you’ve been looking for an excuse to shake up your fighting style, this might just be it.

Cyberware enhances your stats and abilities — but what if it could take your style to the next level, too? That’s where glamdocs come in. These new vendors let you customize the appearance of your cyberware, with 40 styles in different colors to choose from. Fancy a new look for your chrome? Pay them a visit at one (or all) of the five locations across Night City and see what catches your eye.

In a city that lives and dies by appearances, V really can’t afford to pass up any opportunity to shake up their look. On top of cyberware customization, we’ve also added 20 new hairstyles and several clothing sets to give your V the best chance of standing out, even in Night City.

We know how creative the Cyberpunk 2077 community can be, and we’re always curious to see what players come up with. That’s why we’re introducing cross-platform mod support through mod.io integration.

The update adds a Mods panel where you can browse and install supported community-created content directly in the game. It’s a new way to experiment with your experience, and we’re looking forward to seeing how it develops as more mods become available and receive support over time!

We’ve covered some of the bigger additions, but there’s still plenty to find in the Edgerunners 2 Update.

items.content:
Thought you were done with Night City? Well, Night City's not quite done with you!

Patch notes for Cyberpunk 2077's Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) are now available for your early perusal before the update hits the streets on October 22nd. Watch the Features Overview video to see some of the new features in action:

And if you want to know even more, read through the list of most important changes below:

Edgerunners Content

  • Added a new side quest, Clampdown, set before the events of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. To unlock it, complete The Heist and two gigs for Wakako, then wait for a message from her.

    [/*]

  • Added a new 5-piece gear set based on the character King, which can be obtained during the Clampdown side quest.

    [/*]

  • Added a new radio station, HKGN 102.0 FM, featuring a selection of tracks from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners series.

    [/*]

Show Off

  • A brand-new clothing collection has arrived in Night City! 5 new outfit sets can now be purchased from certain clothing vendors:

    • Maxiwear: available in Heywood, Arroyo, Little China

      [/*]

    • Jinguji: available in City Center

      [/*]

    • NetWatch: available in Kabuki, Japantown

      [/*]

    • IconAmerica: available in Pacifica, Badlands, Northside

      [/*]

    • And one more set that will hit Night City shelves just a little later...

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • The NUS Infiltrator clothing set can be now purchased from clothing vendors in Kabuki and Japantown.

    [/*]

  • 4 new TWINTONE skins for Quadra Turbo-R V-Tech are now available via Twitch Drops.

    [/*]

  • Some of the hairstyles that were previously exclusive to NPCs are now available for V. Please note that some hairstyles are available only to feminine or masculine body types.

    [/*]

  • Show off your chrome! You can now customize your hand cyberware. Equip your Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire or Projectile Launch System, and visit one of 5 Glamdocs (marked with a spray paint icon on the map) to give your implants a fresh, new look. Each Glamdoc is located in a unique shop, along with their own intro scene with voiceover and animations, and offers a unique catalog of cyberware skins with customizable colors.

    [/*]

  • Sometimes one gun just isn't enough. The new Double Trouble perk in the Cool tree (along with four auxiliary perks) introduces an entirely new playstyle, allowing you to dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers from the Power category.

    [/*]

  • Added frames from the Cyberpunk Trading Card Game to Photo Mode, allowing you to make your preem shots look like custom cards.

    [/*]

  • Added new poses in Photo Mode to show off your dual-wielding prowess.

    [/*]

Mod the World

Added Cross-Platform Mod Support, powered by mod.io, a first step into cross-platform modding that allows you to easily browse and install a selection of player-created mods directly from the in-game menu. More mods will become available over time. The feature is available on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S.

Upgrading the World

  • Welcome to Paradise! Added a new side quest that takes you on a journey to uncover a mystery and explore Night City on a guided tour narrated by Richard Night. It unlocks after completing The Heist and reaching level 15 Street Cred.

    [/*]

  • Added 12 new Minor Arcana Tarot Cards to discover across Night City. The Tarot menu now has separate sections for Major and Minor Arcana. The new tarot cards are part of a new side quest, an extension of Fool on the Hill, which activates after scanning any of the new cards. Collect them all to get a special reward.

    [/*]

Quality of Life

  • Saves in the “Load Game” menu are now grouped by separate playthroughs.

    [/*]

  • Added item filters to apartment and vehicle stashes.

    [/*]

  • Modded saves in the "Load Game" menu are now marked with a dedicated icon. Please note that achievements and trophies cannot be earned while playing on console from a modded save file.

    [/*]

  • Updated the selection of AMD FSR options. FSR 3 upscaling is no longer included, while FSR 2.1, FSR 4, and FSR 3.1 Frame Generation remain available.

    [/*]

  • Updated the CD PROJEKT RED Account connection, My Rewards and telemetry consent menus.

    [/*]

Technology

  • Added support for DLSS 4.5, including up to 6X Multi Frame Generation or Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and the 2nd Generation Transformer Model.

    [/*]

  • Added support for glasses-free 3D effects on compatible Samsung Odyssey 3D monitors, along with a Motion Comfort setting that lets you balance 3D depth and viewing comfort.

    [/*]

  • Added support for MetalFX Frame Interpolation on Mac.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle in settings for FSR Anti-Lag 2.

    [/*]

  • Introduced various performance optimizations, including improvements specifically for Ray Tracing.

    [/*]

  • Improved HDR rendering to provide more accurate colors, brightness, and contrast on compatible displays.

    [/*]

Fixes

  • Things Done Changed- Fixed an issue where the Delamain cab could get stuck after crashing into another vehicle, blocking quest progression.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where enabling Film Grain had no effect.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where tagging enemies while scanning could also cause V to crouch or stand up when using certain control schemes.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where controller settings for the Third-Person Camera were missing.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several typos in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added various other fixes for features and content introduced since Patch 2.1.

    [/*]

items.content:
To survive in Night City, you need someone to watch your back. On the way to the major leagues, V managed to gather a remarkable crew. You could even say, a crew to remember!

From trusted allies to unforgettable personalities, these are the people who helped shape V’s journey through the City of Dreams. This episode of It’s All About You is dedicated to the legendary crew that stood by V through every high and low.

Thank you for staying with us and expressing your love for Cyberpunk 2077 in the most creative ways possible. Don’t forget to check out our gallery to see more works, and, of course, share your creations with us: http://cdpred.ly/AAY

See you in the next episode!

items.title: It’s All About You! — Never Fade Away

items.content:
Listen up, Samurai! 🤘🔥

Celebrate five years of Cyberpunk 2077 in this special anniversary episode of It’s All About You, looking back on Night City’s unforgettable stories through the legends and music you met along your journey!

Sure, the city’s full of noise — sirens, synths, gunfire in the distance — but if there’s one song that became its soul, it’s “Never Fade Away.”

We brought together legendary artists from across the city of dreams to reinterpret this iconic track — each in their own voice, their own style, their own rebellion. ❤️‍🔥

Plug in, turn it up, and dive into our latest It’s All About You episode.

Because legends don’t fade.
